rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.title: Compact, practical Indian cooking
rooms.finishes: Ivory wall-cabinet front, pale oak base fronts and a light stone worktop.
furniture: L-shaped 600 mm-deep counters for one main cook; no island.

A fixed three-burner gas hob and a separate fixed single-zone induction unit on the right counter; sink on the front counter. The two product reservations have 190 mm between them, subject to manufacturer approval.
A 600 × 650 mm refrigerator reservation at the left of the entrance leaves about 1178 mm to the opposite counter; door opening, ventilation and appliance cut-outs remain to be checked.
A 1400 mm ivory upper-cabinet run on the solid front wall, with a proposed 650 mm gap above the 900 mm worktop; it stops before KW.
rooms.lighting: 4000 K under-cabinet task strips plus a ceiling light.
rooms.services: For one main cook, with BOTH cooking units fixed in the counter: three gas burners and one induction zone. Coordinate gas supply/isolation, induction circuit and ventilation beneath the unit, sink/waste, filtered water, fridge and externally ducted extraction. Circuit ratings, duct size and gas route require chosen product instructions. Place accessible isolation outside hot/wet zones; do not discharge the hood into another room.
rooms.climate: Use sealed exterior-grade plywood at wet cabinet zones. Open front/SE space provides a possible hood discharge direction, subject to duct routing and outlet clearances; do not assume the side gap is suitable.
